definitions.Hy: whole-body centroidal angular momentum about world y (RES-85E sealed convention)

actuation_authority.rule: unchanged; RES-86 adds no bypass, override or state write
actuation_authority.scope: every native sample of the branch scope

body_weight.definition: V3 SYSTEM weight = (79 kg athlete + 20 kg load) * 9.81 m/s^2

classification.statement: The frozen limits are owner engineering task bounds with a predeclared sensitivity domain.  They are not elite-soccer normative physiology and no human-capability claim is derived.

dwells.semantics: D_EST is the allowance from E8_FIRST_CONTACT to bilateral establishment; D_BL is the bilateral-loaded sustain dwell that confirms E10.  They are separate quantities and one value is never reused for the other.  Both are PHYSICAL_TIME dwells: the runtime authority is t_current - t_onset >= D, never a sample count.  The inclusive true-sample count is diagnostic only.

event_labels.E10_CONFIRMATION: first native sample at or after E9_bilateral_onset + D_BL satisfying the sustained E10 predicate
event_labels.E10_IMPACT_ABSORPTION: bilateral established then both feet loaded sustained for D_BL with abs(com_vz) < V_ABS_TAIL continuously
event_labels.E11_BALANCE_CAPTURE: RES-82 E11; OD-05 bounds; deferred to RES-87
event_labels.E8_FIRST_CONTACT: first native sample after physical flight with at least one legal plantar floor contact row and foot clearance <= 0
event_labels.E9_BILATERAL_ESTABLISHED: first native sample after E8_FIRST_CONTACT where both feet have legal plantar contact rows and both feet carry Fz > F_thr
event_labels.PRE_TOUCHDOWN: last native sample before any post-flight floor contact
event_labels.note: The RES-82 event contract numbers the apex E8 and first physical re-contact E9/LANDING_FIRST_CONTACT.  The RES-86 branch authority uses E8_FIRST_CONTACT as the branch label for the first physical re-contact after flight (the mission branch point); it is the same physical event as the RES-82 LANDING_FIRST_CONTACT.

gate_closure_status.principle: thresholds are frozen here; closure status is per gate and never silently promoted

handoff.RES86A: authority + branch evidence + lossless recorder foundation only
handoff.RES86B: active-set-safe derivative and branch validation against the captured branch state
handoff.RES87: L4-T8 behavioral window, E11 bounds (OD-05) and E12 stable-recovery envelope

od_decisions_carried.OD-04: L4 landing numeric bounds (medium candidate set)

physical_gates.branch_scope: [E8_FIRST_CONTACT, end of executed branch] for chatter, material reflight, frozen structural ROM and RES-85 hard actuation authority
physical_gates.chatter_transition_definition: native samples k > E8_FIRST_CONTACT whose boolean legal plantar support (legal_plantar_active > 0) differs from sample k - 1
physical_gates.landing_gate_scope: [E8_FIRST_CONTACT, E10_CONFIRMATION] for penetration, peak Fz, prohibited/fall, E10 point gates and first-contact-to-E10 window gates
physical_gates.material_reflight_definition: a legal-support-free native interval after E8_FIRST_CONTACT of at least D_BL_S (shorter losses are chatter)
physical_gates.peak_fz_definition: max total_floor_force_world_n[2] (every active floor contact, including prohibited/fall load) / BW_N
physical_gates.penetration_definition: max over all detected contacts of max(0, -contact.dist) in the landing gate scope

provenance: RES-84 SAMPLING_RESAMPLING_AUTHORITY timestep obligation (>= 1000 Hz candidates require dt <= 0.001 s)
sensitivity_predeclaration.rule: No broad sensitivity search is executed in RES-86A.  RES-86B may run targeted derivative/branch checks; the final solution verification sweep belongs to RES-89/RES-91.

structural_rom.inherits: RES-85D strict structural-ROM comparison semantics (audit/EXP-RES85-CAUSAL-LAUNCH-FLIGHT-CONTROL-001); the joint ranges themselves are unchanged and the tolerance is never added anatomical ROM
structural_rom.scope: every bounded joint coordinate, every native sample of the branch scope

threshold_friction.role: per-foot loaded predicate for bilateral establishment (RES-82/OD-09); never defines physical takeoff or flight

vertical_rates.E10_sustain: abs(com_vz) < V_ABS_TAIL_M_S at every native sample of the E10 run
vertical_rates.E8_E9_onset: com_vz < -V_DESC_M_S at the first-contact sample (descending COM)
